# Knowunity

> > Knowunity is an AI-powered 24/7 personal tutor platform offering personalized learning support, study notes, and homework help across multiple subjects.

Knowunity provides an AI chat tutor and learning platform designed to help students master subjects like Mathematics, Biology, and test preparation (SAT/ACT). The platform combines an intelligent study companion with a comprehensive knowledge base of educational content across algebra, geometry, calculus, and life sciences.

## Key Topics

- AI Tutor
- Personalized Learning
- Mathematics
- Algebra
- Geometry
- Calculus
- Trigonometry
- Biology
- Cell Biology
- Photosynthesis
- SAT/ACT Prep
- Homework Help
- Study Companion
- 24/7 Support
- Student Learning Platform

## Core Platform

- [AI Chat - Your Personal AI Tutor](https://knowunity.com): Knowunity homepage: AI-powered 24/7 tutor with personalized learning support
- [Mathematics Knowledge Base](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics): Mathematics knowledge base: 96 domains covering algebra, geometry, calculus, and trigonometry

## Mathematics Reference

- [Linear Equations and Graphs](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/linear-equations-and-graphs-2): Algebra reference: linear equations, graphing, slope-intercept form
- [Trigonometric Functions and Identities](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/trigonometric-functions-and-identities-2): Trigonometry reference: functions, identities, derivatives, formulas
- [Triangle Congruence and Similarity Theorems](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/triangle-congruence-and-similarity-theorems-2): Geometry reference: triangle congruence postulates, similarity theorems
- [Triangle Properties and Classification](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/triangle-properties-and-classification-2): Geometry fundamentals: triangle properties, classification, trigonometry
- [Geometric Angle Relationships](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/geometric-angle-relationships-2): Geometry fundamentals: angle relationships, parallel lines, transversals
- [Circle Geometry Fundamentals](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/circle-geometry-fundamentals-2): Geometry: circle properties, arcs, sectors, central angles, area
- [Equation Solving Techniques](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/equation-solving-techniques-2): Algebra methods: equation solving, systems, inequalities, step-by-step
- [Basic Differentiation Rules](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/basic-differentiation-rules-2): Calculus reference: differentiation rules, chain rule, derivatives
- [Exponent and Logarithm Properties](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/exponent-and-logarithm-properties-2): Algebra reference: exponent and logarithm properties, rules
- [Division Operations and Methods](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/mathematics/division-operations-and-methods-2): Math operations: division, fractions, long division, polynomials

## Biology Reference

- [Human Organ Systems](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/human-organ-systems-2): Biology reference: human organ systems, anatomy, physiology
- [Reproductive Cell Cycles](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/reproductive-cell-cycles-2): Cell biology: mitosis, meiosis, cell division, reproduction
- [Cellular Energy Metabolism](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/cellular-energy-metabolism-2): Cell biology: cellular respiration, ATP, Krebs cycle, glycolysis
- [Autotrophic Energy Processes](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/autotrophic-energy-processes-2): Biology: photosynthesis, Calvin cycle, biogeochemical cycles
- [Biological Sciences Subdisciplines](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/biological-sciences-subdisciplines-2): Biology overview: subdisciplines, anatomy, physiology, embryology
